summary: LTX spatial upscaler bench evaluation - successor to the dropped SeedVR2. Weight and nodes are already on disk/core, so no integration tax; the decisive test is the radial-FFT top/mid character measurement plus the 16 GB ceiling.

Folded in the upscale-then-interpolate idea rather than carding it separately: fewer frames per pass moves the chunk ceiling and the interpolator enforces temporal coherence. rife47.pth is on disk and the interpolation nodes are core.
MPI-557 is now blocked on this card - unblock it when this bench reports.
Implementation started - bench evaluation of the LTX spatial upscaler.
Checklist derived from the new plan.md - 7 phases, 6 and 7 gated on the phase 4 radial-FFT verdict.
Ownership written to files.json: the card workspace only. Bench card - it edits no repo code by design.
Fabio closed Q2/Q3/Q5 by eye - sigma 0.50 keeps her, keeps the iris, keeps the zipper; 0.85 replaces the person and deletes the zipper. sigmas IS the exposed knob.

Wavy distortion root-caused to the LTX VAE round trip (13x codec floor), amplified ~2x by the temporal upscaler. Frame-count and geometric-warp hypotheses both falsified by their own controls. New instrument wave.py; ground-truth redo done with legal 8n+1 counts.
Q2/Q3/Q5 checked off plus the fps fix and the ground-truth redo; hybrid temporal arm, attention_mask, x1.5 and clip B remain.

Corrected: sigmas is NOT the change knob - it moves change and quality together. Built the op Fabio asked for instead: detail transfer, 63% less drift at full reconstruction, also attenuates the swim, no GPU, adjustable after the run. Controlled against a drift-matched unsharp mask.

x1.5 spatial upscaler does NOT solve the VRAM ceiling - 15484 MB peak against x2 15301 with 43% fewer output pixels. It is 40% faster (157s vs 263s). First uncontended full-length timing: 97 s per second of footage at 2x.

Split-radius sweep DONE and NEGATIVE. r=2..20 on frames 12/40/65: invention/reconstruction ratio worst at r=2 (0.511), best at r=8-10 (0.345), and every drift-matched strength twin sits at a constant 0.347 - radius is strength in disguise. Luma-only arm negative too: the veins are luma, not a red cast. Leave the radius at 10.

The measurement that killed the radius hypothesis named the control that works: an EVIDENCE-GATED transfer, weighting the transfer by the sources own local high-pass so flat skin and flat fabric get nothing. Proof on an untuned region - ungated detail-100 invents three red dots on plain fabric, the gated arm loses them and keeps the seams buttons. FULL_gated132.mp4 rendered at 81 frames, drift-matched to FULL_detail100.mp4. band_split.py may NEVER score the gate: it shares the gates statistic. Awaiting Fabios eyes.

Fabios verdict on the evidence gate: PARTIAL PASS. Veins gone; fabric speckles only partly gone (the three dots was an under-count from one crop); expressions lost; a new face artifact that feels like bad interpolation. Leading hypothesis for the last: the gate is recomputed per frame and flickers, pulsing the detail layer. Zero GPU to test.

THE POSITIVE PROMPT IS AN UNCONTROLLED VARIABLE UNDER EVERY MEASUREMENT ON THIS CARD. build_v2v.py conditions on a woman s face in close up, natural skin texture, freckles, sharp eyes by default and always has - it ASKS for the speckled skin every downstream dial has been filtering out. cfg 1 also makes the negative prompt inert. Re-baseline sigma 0.85 with a neutral and an empty prompt before any more post-processing work.
